title: The Scarecrow Plans an Escape
chineseTitle: 第一章：稻草人计划越狱

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow and Jack Pumpkinhead were playing quoits in the courtyard when suddenly, the Royal Army of Oz burst in without their leader's hat or gun, disheveled and breathless.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人和南瓜头杰克正在院子里玩飞镖，突然，奥兹皇家军队在没有首领的帽子和枪支的情况下闯了进来，狼狈不堪，气喘吁吁。

paragraphs.en: "Score one for me," said the Scarecrow calmly. "What’s wrong?" he asked the Soldier.
paragraphs.zh: “我算赢了一次。”稻草人冷静地说，“怎么了？”他问士兵。

paragraphs.en: "Oh! Your Majesty—The City is conquered!" gasped the Soldier.
paragraphs.zh: “哦！陛下来临——城市已被征服了！”士兵喘息着说道。

paragraphs.en: "This is sudden," noted the Scarecrow. "Go bar all doors and windows while I teach Jack how to throw a quoit."
paragraphs.zh: “来得这么突然，”稻草人说道，“你去把所有门窗都关好，我去教杰克投掷标枪。”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier hurried off, leaving Tip in the courtyard to watch the Scarecrow with curiosity.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵匆匆离去，留下提普在庭院里好奇地盯着稻草人。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Jack approached Tip excitedly. "Good afternoon, noble parent! I'm glad you're here.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，杰克兴奋地走近蒂普，喊道：“下午好，高贵的父辈！很高兴您能到来。”

paragraphs.en: The Saw-Horse ran away with me," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 他说道：“木马带着我跑了。”

paragraphs.en: "I suspected it," replied Tip. "Did you get hurt? Are you cracked?"
paragraphs.zh: “我早就怀疑是这样了，”提普回答，“你受伤了吗？骨头裂开了吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No, I arrived safely," answered Jack. "His Majesty has been very kind."
paragraphs.zh: “不，我平安到了。”杰克回答道，“国王陛下非常仁慈。”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier returned and the Scarecrow asked, "Who conquered me?"
paragraphs.zh: 士兵回来了，稻草人问道：“是谁打败了我？”

paragraphs.en: "A regiment of girls from Oz," replied the Soldier, still pale.
paragraphs.zh: “奥兹国的一支女兵队伍，”士兵答道，脸色依旧苍白。

paragraphs.en: "Where was my army?" inquired his Majesty.
paragraphs.zh: “我的军队在哪里？”国王问道。

paragraphs.en: "Running," admitted the Soldier truthfully.
paragraphs.zh: “跑吧，”士兵诚实地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Well," said the Scarecrow after a moment. "I don't mind losing my throne—it's a tiresome job. And this crown hurts my head.
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”稻草人沉思了一会儿说，“我不介意放弃我的王位——那份工作挺烦人的。而且这顶王冠还疼得厉害。”

paragraphs.en: But I hope the conquerors won’t harm me just because I'm King."
paragraphs.zh: 但我希望征服者不会仅仅因为我是国王就对我下手。

paragraphs.en: Tip mentioned that the Winkies planned to use Scarecrow’s outer layer for a rug and his insides for cushion stuffing. This alarmed Scarecrow, who decided it was wise to consider an escape.
paragraphs.zh: Tip 提到，Winkie 人打算用稻草人的外皮做地毯，把他的内脏用来填充垫子。这令稻草人感到震惊，他决定趁早考虑逃跑的事情。

paragraphs.en: "Where could you go?" asked Jack Pumpkinhead.
paragraphs.zh: “你还能去哪儿？”杰克南瓜头问道。

paragraphs.en: "To my friend, the Tin Woodman," replied Scarecrow. "He would protect me."
paragraphs.zh: “我那位铁皮木匠朋友，”稻草人回答说，“他会保护我的。”

paragraphs.en: Tip looked out the window and reported that the palace was surrounded by enemies. It was too late to escape; they would be torn apart.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普探头望向窗外，报告说王宫已被敌人围困，逃跑已经来不及了，他们将难逃一劫。

paragraphs.en: Scarecrow sighed and paused to reflect. Jack Pumpkinhead worried about his own fate, fearing he might spoil if held prisoner for long.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人叹了口气，停了下来沉思片刻。杰克南瓜头则为自己未来的命运担忧，害怕长时间被囚禁会导致他变质。

paragraphs.en: "Let's think," said Scarecrow soothingly. "We'll find a way out together."
paragraphs.zh: “让我们冷静想想，”稻草人温和地说，“我们一起想办法逃出去。”

paragraphs.en: For five minutes, the Scarecrow stood with his back against the wall, deep in thought. When he turned to face them again, his expression was more hopeful.
paragraphs.zh: 五分钟里，稻草人背靠墙站着，陷入了深思。当他再次转过身面对他们时，脸上的表情显得更加充满希望。

paragraphs.en: "Where’s the Saw-Horse?" asked Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “马蹄锯哪儿去了？”稻草人问道。

paragraphs.en: Jack explained that Tip had locked it away in the royal treasury.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克解释说，蒂普把它锁在了王室金库中。

paragraphs.en: "It's a good place," said Scarecrow. "Has the horse been fed?"
paragraphs.zh: “这里挺不错。”稻草人说道，“马喂过了吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I gave him sawdust."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我给他填充了锯末。”

paragraphs.en: "Excellent!" cried Scarecrow. "Bring the horse here at once."
paragraphs.zh: “太好了！”稻草人喊道，“立刻把马牵过来。”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier hurried off, and soon they heard the clattering of the Saw-Horse’s wooden legs as it was led into the courtyard.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵匆匆离去，不久他们便听到了木马的木腿在院子里发出的咯吱声。

paragraphs.en: Scarecrow examined the horse critically. "He doesn’t seem graceful," he mused, "but I suppose he can run."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人仔细打量着那匹马，自言自语道：“他看起来不够优雅，”但他补充说，“不过我想他跑得挺快的。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow declared, "With him carrying us on his back, we must dash through the rebel ranks to reach my friend the Tin Woodman."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人宣布道：“由他背着我们穿过叛军的阵营，我们就能赶到铁皮人朋友那里了。”

paragraphs.en: Tip objected, "He can't carry four!"
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普反对说：“他一次只能扛三个！”

paragraphs.en: His Majesty suggested, "Let's leave three behind. He was easily defeated, so I lack confidence in his strength."
paragraphs.zh: 国王提议：“留下三个。他轻易就被击败了，我对他的实力没多少信心。”

paragraphs.en: Tip laughed and said, "Still, he can run."
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普笑了笑说：“不过他还是能跑的。”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier grumbled but agreed, disguising himself by cutting off his green whiskers.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵嘟囔着同意了，为了掩饰自己，他剪掉了绿色的胡须。

paragraphs.en: "Mount first," ordered His Majesty to Tip, who climbed quickly onto the Saw-Horse's back. The Scarecrow helped the Pumpkinhead sit behind him, leaving little room for the King.
paragraphs.zh: “先上马背。”国王命令蒂普，蒂普迅速爬上了锯木马的背。稻草人帮南瓜头坐在他身后，留给国王的位置就非常狭小了。

paragraphs.en: "Fetch a clothesline and tie us together," instructed His Majesty. "If one falls, we all fall."
paragraphs.zh: “去拿一根晾衣绳，把我们绑在一起。”国王命令道，“一个人倒下，大家都会跟着倒下。”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier returned with a line, securing them tightly to the Saw-Horse.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵回来后拿来一根绳子，把他们紧紧地绑在木马上。

paragraphs.en: "Now open the gates," commanded the Scarecrow. They stood in the courtyard of the palace, leading the Saw-Horse through a passage to an outer gateway barred by order of His Majesty.
paragraphs.zh: “现在打开城门，”稻草人命令道。他们站在宫殿的庭院里，带着锯齿马穿过一条通道，前往一道由国王下令封闭的外侧大门。

paragraphs.en: The gate swung open loudly as they escaped into the night.
paragraphs.zh: 他们趁夜色逃出，大门发出 loud 的声响猛然敞开。

paragraphs.en: Tip instructed the Saw-Horse, "Run as fast as you can for the gate of the City. Don't let anything stop you."
paragraphs.zh: Tip 对木马说：“你赶紧跑向城市的城门，什么都别管，不要让它拦住你。”

paragraphs.en: The Saw-Horse dashed away abruptly, causing Tip to gasp for breath and hold onto a post he had driven into its neck.
paragraphs.zh: 木马飞速跑开，吓得Tip喘不过气来，他紧紧抓住一根插在木马上颈上的桩子。

paragraphs.en: Several girls guarding the palace were knocked over by the horse's rush. A few tried to jab their knitting-needles at the escaping prisoners but only pricked Tip slightly in his left arm.
paragraphs.zh: 几名守卫宫殿的少女被马匹冲撞摔倒。有几个女孩试图用她们的编织针刺向逃跑的囚犯，但只在蒂普的左臂上留下了一点小伤。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow and Jack Pumpkinhead, however, remained unaffected as they rode on without suspicion.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，稻草人和南瓜头杰克在骑马前行时并未察觉到任何异样。

paragraphs.en: Outside the city walls, the Saw-Horse continued its mad dash, overturning a fruit cart and several men. It finally knocked over the new Guardian of the Gate—a fussy little fat woman appointed by General Jinjur.
paragraphs.zh: 城外，木马继续狂奔，撞翻了一辆水果车和几名行人。最终，它撞倒了新任的守门人——金jur将军任命的一名爱挑剔的小胖妇人。

paragraphs.en: The horse did not stop. Once outside the Emerald City, it dashed westward with violent leaps that shook Tip's breath out and filled the Scarecrow with wonder.
paragraphs.zh: 马并没有停步。出了翡翠城后，它以迅猛的跳跃向西狂奔，Tip的呼吸因此变得急促，而稻草人则被这惊心动魄的速度震撼不已。

paragraphs.en: Jack had ridden at this rate before, so he held his pumpkin head firmly on its stick, enduring the jolting with philosophical courage.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克以前骑马时也经历过这样的颠簸，所以他紧紧地把南瓜脑袋固定在木棍上，以哲学般的勇气忍受着这番摇晃。

paragraphs.en: "Slow him up! Slow him up!" shouted the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “快把他慢下来！快把他慢下来！”稻草人喊道。

paragraphs.en: "My straw is all shaking down into my legs."
paragraphs.zh: “稻草都在往我的腿上掉落。”

paragraphs.en: But Tip was too breathless to respond. The Saw-Horse continued at full speed.
paragraphs.zh: 但是Tip喘息不止，无法回应。木马则全速前行。

paragraphs.en: They soon reached a wide river. Without pausing, the wooden horse gave one final leap and launched them all into mid-air.
paragraphs.zh: 他们很快来到了一条宽阔的河流前。木马没有停顿，猛地一跳，将所有人抛向了半空。

paragraphs.en: A moment later, they were rolling and splashing in the water. The horse struggled to find footing while Tip and Jack bobbed up and down like corks, first submerged by the current and then floating on the surface.
paragraphs.zh: 片刻之后，他们已经在水中翻滚、溅水。马匹努力寻找立足点，而蒂普和杰克则像木塞一样上下起伏，先是被水流淹没，随后又浮出水面。
